title: Order integration instability
description: Repeated order integration failures indicate an underlying integration reliability problem.
root_cause: Authentication failures are causing repeated integration requests to be rejected.
investigation_findings: Multiple incidents originated from the same integration component.
Failures increased during scheduled integration activity.
Authentication errors were observed across repeated events.
corrective_action: Validate and correct the integration authentication configuration.
preventive_action: Introduce authentication health checks and proactive credential-expiry monitoring.

title: Order API performance degradation
description: Repeated response-time degradation requires investigation of the underlying performance condition.
investigation_findings: API response time exceeded the defined operational threshold.
